semantic_gaps.already_defined: Engine operation/resource responsibility is settled. requirements.title: Data loss at interchange boundaries
requirements.normative_statement: CRS metadata stored in `customData` or proprietary attributes is routinely stripped during USD export/import cycles across different tools.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: No standard for CRS inheritance
requirements.normative_statement: Without a defined inheritance model, every prim in a large scene must redundantly carry CRS metadata, or tools must implement ad-hoc resolution logic.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Precision hazards
requirements.normative_statement: A UTM easting of 481,948 m exceeds the useful range of `float32`, and implementations store it in a `point3f` array anyway, because nothing tells them not to. The result is visible jitter and drift in scenes that look correct on paper.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Multi-CRS composition is undefined
requirements.normative_statement: A cross-state pipeline spans UTM zones 11 and 12, and a regional twin draws on imagery, terrain and vectors that each arrive in their own CRS. Today the only way to put them on one stage is to convert them all first, which is a cost the largest projects cannot pay.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Industry adoption is blocked
requirements.normative_statement: GIS vendors, AECO tool makers, and digital twin platforms cannot fully adopt USD without a standard way to express CRS, because it is a foundational requirement for their workflows.
requirements.current_evidence: Bounded executed evidence is recorded separately. A passed control does not certify a complete functional requirement.

requirements.title: Minimal disruption

verification_gaps: Q9 geographic scene geometry, frames and bounds remains a design question; geographic coordinate queries remain supported.
Continuous nonlinear extent and between-sample trajectory guarantees are unsupported, with visible failure rather than an inferred certificate.
C++ validation is not a second independent WKT normalizer. External format decoding is shared; Python and C++ share PROJ, while OV reuses the Python placement algorithm.
Hydra consumes an ordinary resolved export; no live geospatial scene-index filter or physics integration is claimed.
External adapters cover selected CF, single-IFD GeoTIFF and RFC 7946 domains, not all coordinate forms in those standards.
Export preserves tested geometry/sample associations but materializes instances; authored shading-normal and general material/primvar semantics are not certified.

implementation_gaps.finding: Retained earlier placement implementations expect a crs:binding relationship, while the shared proposal uses reference-based binding. A counterexample tests this incompatibility. Current discovery readers follow composed applied binding and crs:wkt instead.

process_correction: Read the entire pinned proposal. Cite existing answers before identifying the smallest missing authored fact or observable meaning. A chosen internal algorithm or an absent test is not a new proposal gap. Stop the dependent derivation. Never certify a private experimental model as shared-proposal authority.
stopping_policy: At each required semantic choice, cite its exact proposal clause or explicit normative reference.
If that source is missing or conflicting, stop the dependent derivation and immediately report the gap, affected requirement and proposed alternatives.
Continue only independent work or explicitly authorized labeled experiments. Keep their assumptions separate from proposal conformance.
Review any proposed specification repair against requirements and data ownership. Do not approve it because the implementation already uses it.
A semantic change requires a new pinned specification before affected code/tests and invalidates affected evidence.
A missing required test is unfinished verification, not an open design question.
The default build gate stops while specification gaps remain. An explicit experimental invocation records proposal_ready=false and requirements_build_complete=false.
postimplementation_audit_required: Map every authored field to a source property contract.
Separate internal algorithms from authored facts and new normative choices.
Audit every advertised consumer path against actual sink readback.
Record unsupported combinations and absent tests instead of declaring whole-requirement conformance.
Require source hashes and immutable receipts before delivery.
